#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long number;
    cin >> number;
    vector<long long> powers(19, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 18; ++i) {
        powers[i] = powers[i - 1] * 10;
    }
    vector<long long> sum_powers(19, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 18; ++i) {
        sum_powers[i] = sum_powers[i - 1] + powers[i];
    }
    int max_power = 1;
    while (max_power <= 18 && sum_powers[max_power] <= number) {
        ++max_power;
    }
    --max_power;

    int answer = INT_MAX;

    function<void(int, long long, int)> dfs = [&](int level, long long current_num, int cost) {
        if (current_num == 0) {
            answer = min(answer, cost);
            return;
        }
        if (level == 0) return;
        long long base = powers[level];
        int i;
        for (i = -10; i * base <= current_num; ++i);
        dfs(level - 1, current_num - (i - 1) * base, cost + abs(i - 1) * (level + 1));
        dfs(level - 1, current_num - i * base, cost + abs(i) * (level + 1));
    };

    dfs(max_power, number, 0);
    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
